مَغْنًى : see 4, former half: ―
-b2- and غَنًى: ―
-b3- and غِنًى, near the end. ―
-b4- Also A place in which were its occupants, or inhabitants: (S:) or a place of abode by which its occupants, or inhabitants, were sufficed, or with which they were satisfied, or content, and from which they then departed, or removed: or in a general sense; (K, TA;) a place of abode, absolutely; but this seems to be a distinct application: (TA:) pl. مَغَانٍ; with the article, المَغَانِى. (S, TA.) ＝
-A2- See also غِنَآءٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
